segments.name: Cinematic visualization
products: TrueCut Motion content creation software tools
segments.description: Licensing and services for content creation, remastering, video streaming and cinematic display, for filmmakers and display makers.
segments.evidence: Following the sale of PWSH, we continue to operate in one segment consisting of licensing and services for content creation, remastering and video streaming, and display of cinematic video.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for remastering services and for licenses to TrueCut Motion technology, including license fees and royalty fees.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate our revenue primarily from services provided for remastering content and from licensing.

changes.text: In 2026 the company sold its PWSH semiconductor business and no longer operates Mobile or Home & Enterprise businesses.
changes.evidence: As a result of the Sale, Pixelworks no longer operates a semiconductor business, which included the businesses that it previously described as "Mobile" (smartphone and tablet) and "Home & Enterprise" (projectors, personal video recorders, and over-the-air streaming devices).
